description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the variable 'N' and the percentage of AUC across multiple datasets or conditions. The x-axis is labeled 'N', has a linear scale, and spans values from 0 to 20, marked at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled 'AUC (%)', also has a linear scale, and ranges from 75 to 100, marked at intervals of 5. The plot contains five lines, each representing a different dataset or condition: the light blue line with circle markers starts at approximately (1, 94), peaks at (10, 99), and ends at (20, 94); the orange line with square markers begins at (1, 87), peaks at (10, 98), and declines to (20, 91); the green line with star markers starts at (1, 86), rises to (15, 94), and stabilizes at (20, 93); the magenta line with inverted triangle markers begins at (1, 80), peaks sharply at (10, 96), and then drops to (20, 81); the yellow line with diamond markers starts at (1, 84), rises to a peak at (15, 95), and then slightly decreases to (20, 94).
